scope: Qualification exit evidence guard; a failed/incomplete run cannot qualify through a zero marker

retainedMisleadingWrapperAssessment.reason: The wrapper reused its outer exit-code variable while reading exception codes. AssertionError replaced it with None; successful container cleanup then replaced it with zero. App failure and missing native final invariants make this an unsuccessful run.

coverage: Explicit failure fields override an attempted zero exit
Every named required check must be literal True; empty/malformed/duplicate requirements refuse
Cleanup evidence must be a nonempty sequence of integer zero statuses; booleans and strings refuse
Invalid/boolean/negative/out-of-range attempted exit codes refuse; real nonzero errors remain nonzero
Actual failed host-native v2 report is rejected despite its incorrectly written zero exit marker
limits: This is harness integrity, not a product/native/client success claim
Earlier raw reports/markers are retained unchanged; consumers must use the corrective assessment for v2
No native source, authority, admission or production timeout gate changed
